title: Reject unsupported runtime-backed semantics edges before IR support claims widen
source:
// IMPLEMENTATION-ANCHOR: scripts/build_objc3c_runtime_backed_semantics_closure.py --check
// Negative matrix: escaping block with actor handoff -> O3S294, throw without throws/local handler -> O3S274, catch-body rethrow without throws/local handler -> O3S284, throwing call without try -> O3S341, task group operation outside scope -> O3S228, actor hop outside async actor method -> O3S289

diagnostics.message: escaping block literals remain unsupported in actor methods that perform task handoff
throw statements require a throws function or an enclosing do/catch handler
rethrow from catch requires a throws function or an enclosing do/catch handler
throwing function 'risky' must be called with try, try?, or try!
task-group add, wait-next, and cancel-all calls require a task-group scope in the same async function or method
actor hop sites require an async actor method

mode_matrix.name: native-runtime-backed-semantics-negative
abi_requirements: Unsupported escaping block plus task-handoff combinations fail closed before a runtime-backed block support claim can be widened
Throw statements outside throws/local-handler contexts fail closed before error-out/runtime bridge lowering claims execution support
Catch-body rethrows outside throws/local-handler contexts fail closed before error-out/runtime bridge lowering claims execution support
Throwing calls outside try operators fail closed before error-out/runtime bridge lowering claims execution support
Task-group operations outside a same-function task-group scope fail closed before task runtime helper declarations are treated as runnable semantics
Actor hop sites outside async actor methods fail closed before actor mailbox/executor helper declarations are treated as runnable isolation semantics

negative_requirements: The closure report must observe nonzero compiler exit codes for all four negative fixtures
The observed diagnostics must contain O3S294, O3S274, O3S284, O3S341, O3S228, and O3S289
No source-of-truth input, conformance fixture, or generated claimability report may live under tmp/
tmp/artifacts may be used only as compiler scratch output regenerated by the runtime-backed semantics implementation anchor
